description: t.holder reserves a Lease and waits on a notify that t.driver signals only after eight yields, so it is not polled for those steps. With lab.futurelock_max_idle_steps 3 Rust's per-step check (panic_on_futurelock off) reports it at every step from its fourth idle step, with the Lease it holds, and the report stops when it is woken, commits and completes (bd-9kll.9.6).
